stop_condition: Done when the tightened findings content class and the rewritten anchored ART_FINDINGS extraction have been examined ONCE for (a) any remaining permitted character that lets a finding value impersonate structure, and (b) any case where the new extraction disagrees with the grammar that accepted the record; then either a finding at or above high, or verdict=approve with findings=[]. BOUNDED: no exhaustive proof of absence. fkm.1.1 must still exit 4; i8cx must still resolve iteration=10/sol-codex/gpt-5.6-sol; model= and pin= must still accept bracketed identifiers.

findings.evidence: The tightened class at line 2083 still permits ERE metacharacters such as `.` and `*`. The anchored extractor faithfully returns `.*:high`, after which `fid=.*` is interpolated unescaped into `grep -E "^RESOLVED ${fid} "` here and the equivalent ARBITRATION lookup at line 2906. Thus any unrelated `RESOLVED R1-F1 fix=x test=y` record matches and clears the declared high finding.
findings.description: A grammar-accepted finding value can impersonate another finding ID as an ERE. An attacker can combine `findings=[.*:high]` with an unrelated or attacker-posted RESOLVED/overrule record and make the gate report zero open findings, so the fix has not ended the structure-impersonation class.
